description: This file defines interfaces, data types, and serializers related to exception handling and message serialization in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes interface definitions for grains that handle exceptions and message serialization, as well as serializer and copier implementations for custom types.

classes.name: UndeserializableType
classes.description: A serializable struct with a constant failure message and a single integer property.

classes.name: UnserializableType
classes.description: An empty class representing a type that is not serializable.

classes.name: UndeserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and deep copier for UndeserializableType, with custom read and write logic.

classes.name: UnserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and deep copier for UnserializableType, with unsupported read/write implementations.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object; in this case, returns the input as-is.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from a reader; for UndeserializableType, throws NotSupportedException; for UnserializableType, returns default.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a field to a writer; for UndeserializableType, writes the integer property; for UnserializableType, throws NotSupportedException.
